exposure: Mental health issues (anxiety, depression, comorbid anxiety and depression)
Physical health issues (e.g., headaches, back pain, constipation, haemorrhoids, etc.)
outcome: Prevalence of comorbid anxiety and depression (CAD)
Number of physical health issues reported
finding: Women reporting mental health symptoms, particularly comorbid anxiety and depression, experienced a significantly higher burden of physical health issues throughout the first year postpartum.
mod_finding: Women who had a caesarean birth had a higher proportion of reporting postpartum comorbid anxiety and depression (CAD).
